title: 第1648章 螳臂当车第1647章 极致暴怒
content_zh:
慕容渊执掌沧澜百万年，从未被人如此轻视、如此践踏！纵使对方功法诡异逆天，可境界天堑摆在眼前，星君便是星君，星帝便是星帝，绝非旁门秘术可以逆转！
“狂妄小辈！仗着诡异道统窃得蛮力，也敢在本帝面前大言不惭！”
慕容渊厉声嘶吼，周身万丈镇世魔身彻底暴走，漆黑魔焰滔天翻滚，无数漆黑魔纹爬满长空，寂灭魔威再度攀升巅峰！
他双手结动无上魔印，镇世魔身一拳轰然轰出！
这一拳承载百万年魔道苦修、星帝巅峰全部本源，裹挟覆灭天地、碾碎星辰的恐怖威势，拳影遮天蔽日，漆黑魔力碾压八方，硬生生击穿混沌气罩，狠狠轰在张皓旸胸口！
”嘭—！“
沉闷震响震荡天地！
张皓旸周身混沌气罡剧烈炸裂、层层溃散，身躯如遭诸天重压，猛然倒飞数万里长空，胸骨咔咔作响，数道裂痕蔓延周身，大口金色道血喷涌而出！
跨阶对战的弊端彻底显露！哪怕混沌之力凌驾万道，可他星君巅峰的肉身底蕴、道基承载，终究难以长时间硬抗星帝巅峰的本源猛攻！
“我看你这混沌本源，能撑得住本帝几击！”
慕容渊眼中闪过一抹残忍冷光，趁势追击，魔身再动，双拳连环轰出！
万千道漆黑魔拳布满长空，每一拳都蕴含镇世灭道之威，层层叠加、连绵不绝，彻底封死张皓旸所有闪避空间，欲以绝对境界蛮力，硬生生耗空他的混沌本源、碾碎他的肉身道基！
危急关头，张皓旸眸光凛冽，强行压下体内翻腾的血气，催动虚空万象诀圆满奥义！
周身千万虚空幻影瞬间衍生、遮蔽天地，真身虚实变幻、穿梭虚空，堪堪避开绝大多数魔拳轰击。可依旧有数道霸道魔拳穿透虚空桎梏，轰击在他的虚空道体之上！
“噗嗤！噗嗤！”
又是数口金色道血喷出，张皓旸道基剧烈震颤，神魂传来阵阵刺痛，浑身经脉多处断裂，战力被迫折损三成！
这便是星帝巅峰的恐怖！底蕴浑厚、本源无尽、招式霸道，纵使被混沌之力克制，依旧能凭借境界天堑碾压、消耗、重创跨阶敌手！
“徒劳挣扎！”
慕容渊冷笑震天，杀意愈发凛冽，万丈镇世魔身张开巨口，酝酿无尽暗黑魔光，凝聚施展禁忌神通—沧澜寂灭魔光！
漆黑无垠的寂灭魔光汇聚一点，浓缩极致毁灭之力，瞬间破空射来，速度超越时空，锁定张皓旸神魂本源，无解无声、避无可避！

张皓旸深知普通神通根本无法抵挡星帝禁忌秘术，不再保留半分底牌！
他双目凝神，周身残余混沌本源尽数燃烧，道基、神魂、肉身全力透支，双手结出双重无上印诀！
“混沌开天！万象帝印！”
“归墟灭世！万道归无！”
两大终极招式再度同时爆发，且是以燃烧自身本源为代价，催动至极限！
玄黄开天帝印镇压苍穹，归墟寂灭之力席卷八方，创世与灭世两大无上奥义完美交融，化作一道横贯天地的混沌神光屏障！
“轰隆—！”
寂灭魔光与混沌神光轰然对撞，天地剧烈震颤，万里虚空层层崩塌！
content_en:
Murong Yuan has been in charge of Canglan for millions of years, and he has never been so despised or trampled upon by others! Even though the other party's skills are weird and unbelievable, the chasm of the realm is right in front of you. Star Lord is Star Lord, Star Emperor is Star Emperor, and no other secret technique can reverse it!
"The arrogant young man! He has stolen brute strength by relying on his strange orthodoxy, and yet he dares to speak so brazenly in front of this emperor!"
Murong Yuan screamed loudly, and the world-suppressing demonic body around him completely went berserk. The dark demonic flames rolled into the sky, countless dark demonic patterns crawled across the sky, and the demonic power of annihilation once again reached its peak!
He formed the Supreme Demonic Seal with both hands and punched out the World-Suppressing Demonic Body!
This fist carries the entire origin of millions of years of devilish hard work and the peak of the Star Emperor. It carries the terrifying power of destroying the world and crushing the stars. The shadow of the fist covers the sky and the sun, and the dark magic power crushes all directions. It breaks through the chaos shield and hits Zhang Haoyang's chest hard!
"Bang—!"
The dull sound shook the world!
The chaotic energy around Zhang Haoyang exploded violently and collapsed layer by layer. As if being pressed by the heavens, his body suddenly flew tens of thousands of miles into the sky. His sternum cracked, several cracks spread all over his body, and a large mouthful of golden blood spurted out!
The shortcomings of cross-level battles are completely exposed! Even though the power of Chaos surpasses ten thousand Dao, his physical foundation and Dao foundation at the peak of the Star Lord will ultimately be difficult to withstand the onslaught of the Star Emperor's origin for a long time!
"I think your chaotic origin can withstand a few blows from this emperor!"
A cruel cold light flashed in Murong Yuan's eyes, and he took advantage of the situation to pursue him. The demonic body moved again, and he punched out with both fists!
Thousands of pitch-black magic fists filled the sky, and each punch contained the power of slaying the world and destroying the Tao. They were superimposed layer by layer and continuously, completely sealing off all Zhang Haoyang's dodge space. He wanted to use absolute brute force to forcefully drain his source of chaos and crush his physical Tao foundation!
At the critical moment, Zhang Haoyang's eyes were piercing, and he suppressed the boiling blood in his body, and activated the Void Vientiane Art to complete the secret!
Thousands of phantoms in the void around him are instantly generated, covering the world, and the real body changes in reality and emptiness, traveling through the void, and is able to avoid the bombardment of most demonic fists. But there were still several domineering demonic fists that penetrated the shackles of the void and bombarded his void body!
"Pfft! Pfft!"
Several mouthfuls of golden Dao blood spurted out again, Zhang Haoyang's Dao base trembled violently, and his soul felt a stinging pain. The meridians all over his body were broken in many places, and his combat strength was forced to lose 30%!
This is the terror of the Star Emperor at his peak! He has a rich foundation, endless origins, and domineering moves. Even if he is restrained by the power of chaos, he can still crush, consume, and severely damage cross-level opponents with the help of the realm's natural chasm!
"Struggle in vain!"
Murong Yuan's sneer shook the sky, his murderous intention became more and more fierce, the world-suppressing demon body opened its huge mouth, brewed endless dark demon light, condensed and used the forbidden magical power-Canglan Silent Demonic Light!
The black and boundless demonic light of annihilation gathered at one point, concentrated the power of ultimate destruction, and shot through the air in an instant. The speed exceeded time and space, locking in the origin of Zhang Haoyang's soul. There was no solution, no sound, and no escape!
Zhang Haoyang knew that ordinary magical powers could not resist the Star Emperor's forbidden secrets, so he no longer kept half of his trump card!
His eyes were focused, and all the remaining chaos origins around his body were burned. His Taoist base, soul, and body were fully exhausted, and his hands formed double supreme seals!
"Chaos opens the sky! The Emperor's Seal of All Things!"
"Return to ruins and destroy the world! All roads will return to nothingness!"
The two ultimate moves exploded at the same time again, at the expense of burning their own origins, pushing them to the limit!
The Xuanhuang Kaitian Emperor's Seal suppresses the sky, and the power of ruin and destruction sweeps across all directions. The two supreme mysteries of creation and destruction are perfectly blended, turning into a barrier of chaotic divine light across the heaven and earth!
"Boom—!"
The demonic light of annihilation collided with the divine light of chaos, the world trembled violently, and layers of void collapsed!
